The Sewer Dweller: A Complex Entity

With Mercury conjunct the 8th house, you're naturally drawn to the mysterious and the unknown, often finding yourself in the darkest, most hidden corners of life. Your communication style is direct, yet cryptic, leaving others to decipher your intentions. (7)

Your Venus in Scorpio suggests a deep-seated need for intensity and passion, often manifesting in intense relationships or obsessive pursuits. Your emotional landscape is complex, with a tendency to attract both light and dark energies. (10)

Your Saturn in Pisces indicates a strong connection to the spiritual realm, but also a propensity for escapism and avoidance. You may struggle with feelings of inadequacy or self-doubt, but your intuition is a powerful guide. (8)

Your North Node in Cancer suggests a need to heal and nurture your emotional roots, but beware of becoming overly attached or codependent. Your true north lies in embracing your inner strength and resilience. (10)
